description: Surviving mutants a maintainer has looked at and accepted: equivalent ones (no input can tell them apart from the original) and ones that only make a check stricter. tests/mutation_check.py leaves these out of its report. An entry matches by module (a measured Python module, .claude/hooks/gate-git-diff.sh, or a workflow or composite action under .github/), operator (cosmic-ray's, one of the bash/ operators tests/mutation_check.py makes for the hook, or one of the yaml/ operators it makes for a workflow or action) and the stripped text of the source line, so it follows the line when code above it moves and stops matching when the line itself changes. tests/test_mutation_check.py fails when an entry's line no longer exists. Say in reason why the mutant cannot matter.

accepted.reason: prev_opt is read only in the branch for a wrapper other than env and exec, and the wrapper's name sets it to 0 before that branch runs, so its starting value is never read.
